description: Defines the 'Module' class and related structures for managing thermal and electrical properties of a battery module, including thermal modeling, state management, and data storage.

classes.name: slide::Module
classes.description: Represents a battery module with thermal and electrical properties, capable of managing child storage units, thermal modeling, and data logging.

methods.name: calculateNcells
methods.description: Calculates total number of cells in the module by summing over child storage units.

methods.name: thermalModel_cell
methods.description: Computes thermal model for a cell.

methods.name: thermalModel_coupled
methods.description: Computes coupled thermal model considering neighboring elements.

methods.name: checkVoltage
methods.description: Checks if the module's voltage is valid.

methods.name: getVhigh
methods.description: Returns the highest cell voltage within the module.

methods.name: getVlow
methods.description: Returns the lowest cell voltage within the module.

methods.name: getStates
methods.description: Retrieves the current states of the module and its children.

methods.name: validStates
methods.description: Checks if the current state configuration is valid.

methods.name: setStates
methods.description: Sets the states of the module and its children.

methods.name: T
methods.description: Returns the current temperature of the module.

methods.name: getThermalSurface
methods.description: Returns the thermal surface area of the module.

methods.name: getCoolingLoad
methods.description: Calculates the cooling energy required for the module and its children.

methods.name: thermalModel
methods.description: Performs thermal modeling considering neighboring elements.

methods.name: setSUs
methods.description: Sets child storage units for the module.

methods.name: getCoolSystem
methods.description: Returns pointer to the cooling system.

methods.name: setRcontact
methods.description: Sets contact resistance for each cell.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the module instance.

methods.name: storeData
methods.description: Stores current data snapshot for the module and children.

methods.name: writeData
methods.description: Writes stored data to a CSV file.

methods.name: setBlockDegAndTherm
methods.description: Blocks or unblocks temperature and thermal calculations.

methods.name: setT
methods.description: Sets the coolant temperature in the module.

methods.name: getNcells
methods.description: Returns total number of cells in the module.

methods.name: getThotSpot
methods.description: Returns the maximum temperature among all cells and the module.
